Comcast / Self-service & operations

Bring support closer to distributed teams.

Self-service to request, replace, borrow and return work equipment.

UX/UI & Product DesignJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

Comcast

A distributed workforce depends on functioning equipment and IT support with limited capacity. Physical distance adds friction to requests and returns.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Bridge the gap between employees and IT by organizing asset requests, replacements and returns into an understandable journey.

02

The solution

Workshops, interviews, personas and journey maps informed a hybrid web and mobile app. Prototypes and iterative testing helped refine self-service processes.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Design for remote employees and support teams.

02

Make borrowing, replacement and return journeys explicit.

03

Validate flows with prototypes and iterative feedback.

04 / The impact

Asset management within the user’s reach

A solution bringing asset management and IT communication into a shared experience. Operational benefits are described qualitatively in the original case.
